items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 76:1
items.html: In the inner vessels of the Partzufim of Atzilut there are only three vessels, KHB, in which NRN clothe, and the lights of Yechida and Chaya clothe within the light of the Neshama. And they are also called the brain, the bones, and the sinews. But the vessels of ZON separated from the body and became outer, surrounding vessels, and they are the discernment of the vessels of skin and flesh, which are not complete vessels but only the discernment of surroundings upon the inner vessels of the body. However, there is in them the illumination of Ruach and Nefesh, which they receive from the inner vessels. Therefore there are two discernments of Nefesh and Ruach in the body: first, the true NRN, clothed in the bones and sinews; second, the Nefesh and Ruach of the externality, clothed in the outer vessels of skin and flesh.
